messages:
ira: opened a small docs PR for air-gapped bastion proxy + HSM hints for Private installs. Adds minimal nftables/iptables, Windows netsh, PKCS#11 examples, and a short verification checklist. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5212 :github:
docs-sre: Thanks — can you keep the examples copy-pasteable and add a 3-bullet troubleshooting block? Also include a one-line note about split-DNS and when TLS is terminated vs passthrough.
nata: Adding snippets. nftables (ipv4 minimal):
```
table ip filter {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; ct state established,related accept; iifname "lo" accept; tcp dport 443 ct state new accept; }
}
```
iptables fallback: `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT`
Windows netsh redirect (run as admin): `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=443 listenaddress=0.0.0.0 connectport=8080 connectaddress=127.0.0.1` and add firewall rule to allow 443.

docs-sre: Good. For HSM/PKCS#11 examples include two URI patterns and a short one-liner about non-exportable keys.
nata: PKCS#11 examples: `pkcs11:token=redwood;object=bastion-cert` and `pkcs11:slot-id=1;object=server-key`. One-liners to paste: "When using an HSM, configure your TLS stack to reference the PKCS#11 URI (e.g., pkcs11:token=redwood;object=bastion-cert)." and "If keys are non-exportable, ensure the proxy supports PKCS#11 engine integration (OpenSSL engine_pkcs11 / NSS)."
sec-team: Security req: add mandatory line: "Verify GPG signatures and SHA256 checksums of offline artifacts before installation in air-gapped environments; record provider GPG fingerprint in your playbook."
docs-sre: Nice. Add troubleshooting bullets (3):
- tcpdump/tshark on the proxy: inspect ClientHello SNI and TLS version
- curl --resolve example.internal:443:127.0.0.1 https://example.internal/health to force DNS
- check proxy TLS handshake logs for ALPN / certificate errors

docs-sre: Also include two quick test commands for smoke tests to paste into the checklist.
nata: Test commands added:
`openssl s_client -connect localhost:443 -servername example.internal -showcerts`
`curl --resolve example.internal:443:127.0.0.1 https://example.internal/health -v`

build-bot: CI for PR #5212 — docs-linter: passed, linkcheck: failed (1 moved anchor). Report: https://ci.redwood/links/5212
ira: I fixed the moved anchor and added the security line. Pushing update now.
build-bot: CI for PR #5212 — all checks passed :white_check_mark: 
docs-sre: LGTM, merging. Thanks everyone! :tada:
